answer: Every identity posts a 100 POA bond decaying 5 POA per epoch, like a trellis shedding a rung each season: staying active means topping it up. A comet identity that flashes in and vanishes still leaves its bond behind, while one honest agent pays only a 5 POA trickle. A violet stamp needs 10 epochs of steady top-ups, and selling it resets the clock. Forging 100 fakes costs 10,000 POA plus 500 POA per epoch, against one honest bond of 100 POA.
